content: Annual oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) screening for cystic fibrosis-related diabetes (CFRD) should begin at the age of 10 years. Hemoglobin A1C (HbA1C) is not an appropriate tool for screening purposes; however, an HbA1C level of 6.5% or higher may suggest the presence of CFRD. The development of CFRD is influenced by genetic predisposition and chronic inflammation. The OGTT is the recommended diagnostic method for identifying abnormalities in glucose metabolism associated with CFRD.
